raw_response:
Well, let me think about this year...

I'm 69 now. I've worked this land for 50 years — since I was a boy. My wife helps when her back is good, and two of my sons are off working in the city, but my daughter-in-law is here with the grandchildren, so we have hands when we need them. Five mu isn't much, but for vegetables it's plenty of work.

My main plot — about 2 mu of the good land near the well — that's my cabbage-chili-cabbage ground. Spring cabbage goes in February, comes out in May. Right after, I put chili in. Then when chili is finishing in October, I push fall cabbage in. That way the land never rests but I know it well, I know what it likes. My neighbor老王 does the same, his chili was good last year so I'm keeping the same variety I've been using — the local one I buy seedlings for at the market.

The other 3 mu I split up. 1 mu cucumber near the house — easy to pick when grandchildren are at school and I can walk over. 1 mu eggplant on the back plot, it takes the heat fine. 1 mu kidney bean on the edge piece — beans don't need much fertilizer, they make their own somehow, my father always said so.

For fertilizer I use what I know. I get chicken manure cheap from the poultry place down the road, I spread that before planting — maybe 3-4 cart loads per mu on the vegetables, less on the beans. Then I buy compound fertilizer (三元复合肥) and some urea from the供销社. For chili I put more — chili is hungry, if you starve it the peppers stay small and nobody buys them. For beans I hardly put any urea, just a little compound. My son says I should test the soil, but I've farmed this soil for 50 years, I know what it needs.

Water — I have the well, but pumping costs electricity. Vegetables need water, especially cucumber and eggplant when it's hot. I irrigate when the leaves start to look tired. For kidney bean much less.

For pests — chili gets aphids some years, cucumber sometimes gets the downy mildew when it's rainy. I walk the fields every morning and if I see trouble I go buy the spray at the agricultural store. I don't spray when there's nothing wrong — that's wasting money.

I can't spend more than maybe 4000-5000 yuan on all the inputs. We need to keep cash for medicine and the grandchildren's school.
